name: E5 A Vol
expression:
VAR __selA = SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario A Switch'[Scenario A])
VAR __scenA = SUBSTITUTE(__selA, " PY", "")
VAR __selB = SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario B Switch'[Scenario B])
VAR __scenB = SUBSTITUTE(__selB, " PY", "")
VAR __tp = SELECTEDVALUE('Time Period Switch'[Time Period Switch])
RETURN
IF(__selA = __scenA,
    IF(__tp = "MTD", CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenA, 'Account Mapping'[Account Name] IN {"Vol"}, DATESMTD('Dates'[Date])), CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenA, 'Account Mapping'[Account Name] IN {"Vol"})),
    IF(__tp = "MTD", CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenA, 'Account Mapping'[Account Name] IN {"Vol"}, DATESMTD('Dates'[Date]), DATEADD('Dates'[Date], -1, YEAR)), CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenA, 'Account Mapping'[Account Name] IN {"Vol"}, DATEADD('Dates'[Date], -1, YEAR))))

VAR __selB = SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario B Switch'[Scenario B])

VAR __accts = TREATAS(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(__bridge, [Row] = __row), "AN", [Account]), 'Account Mapping'[Account Name])
VAR __selA = SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario A Switch'[Scenario A])
VAR __scenA = SUBSTITUTE(__selA, " PY", "")
VAR __selB = SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario B Switch'[Scenario B])
VAR __scenB = SUBSTITUTE(__selB, " PY", "")
VAR __tp = SELECTEDVALUE('Time Period Switch'[Time Period Switch])
VAR __t =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        VALUES('Products'[Level5]),
        "@VolA", [E5 A Vol],
        "@VolB", [E5 B Vol],
        "@ValA", CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenA, __accts),
        "@ValB", CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Value]), 'Financials'[Scenario] = __scenB, __accts))
VAR __TotVolA = SUMX(__t, [@VolA])
VAR __TotVolB = SUMX(__t, [@VolB])
VAR __RateBTot = DIVIDE(SUMX(__t, [@ValB]), __TotVolB)
VAR __val =
SUMX(__t,
    VAR rA = DIVIDE([@ValA], [@VolA])
    VAR rB = DIVIDE([@ValB], [@VolB])
    RETURN
    IF([@VolB] <> 0,
        ([@VolA] - DIVIDE([@VolB], __TotVolB) * __TotVolA) * (rB - __RateBTot),
        (rA - __RateBTot) * [@VolA]))
RETURN
